mn123:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn123:2.1: atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
mn123:2.2: acchariyaṃ āvuso, abbhutaṃ āvuso, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvakatā.
mn123:2.3: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jānissati:
mn123:2.4: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃgottā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃdhammā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃpaññā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃvihārī te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti.
mn123:2.5: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando te bhikkhū etadavoca:
mn123:2.6: acchariyā ceva āvuso, tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca
mn123:2.7: abbhutā ceva āvuso, tathāgatā abbhutadhammasamannāgatā cāti.
mn123:2.8: ayañca hidaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarā kathā vippakatā hoti.
mn123:2.9: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn123:2.11: kāya nuttha bhikkhave, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatāti.
mn123:2.12: idha bhante, amhākaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi:
mn123:2.14: evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipīti. evaṃ vutte bhante, āyasmā ānando amhe etadavoca:
mn123:2.15: acchariyā ceva āvuso, tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca,
mn123:2.17: ayaṃ kho no bhante, antarākathā vippakatā. atha bhagavā anuppattoti.
mn123:2.18: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn123:2.19: tasmātiha taṃ ānanda, bhiyyosomattāya paṭibhantu tathāgatassa acchariyā abbhutadhammāti.
mn123:3.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:3.2: sato sampajāno ānanda, bodhisatto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjīti.
mn123:3.3: yampi bhante, sato sampajāno bodhisatto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajji idamahaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:4.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:4.2: sato sampajāno ānanda, bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsīti.
mn123:4.3: yampi bhante sato sampajāno bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsi. idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:5.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:5.2: yāvatāyukaṃ ānanda, bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsīti.
mn123:5.3: yampi bhante, yāvatāyukaṃ bodhisatto tusite kāye aṭṭhāsi. idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:6.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:6.2: sato sampajāno ānanda, bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātukucchiṃ okkamīti.
mn123:6.3: yampi bhante, sato sampajāno bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātukucchiṃ okkami, idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:7.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:7.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātukucchiṃ okkami.
mn123:7.3: atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
mn123:7.4: yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yatthapime candimasūriyā evaṃmahiddhikā evaṃmahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
mn123:7.5: yepi tattha sattā upapannā, tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti: aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannāti.
mn123:7.6: ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvanti.
mn123:7.7: yampi bhante, …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:8.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:8.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti. cattāro naṃ devaputtā catuddisaṃ ārakkhāya upagacchanti: mā naṃ kho bodhisattaṃ vā bodhisattamātaraṃ vā manusso vā amanusso vā koci vā viheṭhesīti.
mn123:8.3: yampi bhante, …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:9.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:9.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti. pakatiyā sīlavatī bodhisattamātā hoti. viratā pāṇātipātā, viratā adinnādānā, viratā kāmesumicchācārā, viratā musāvādā, viratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānāti.
mn123:9.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:10.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:10.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti. na bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāmaguṇūpasaṃhitaṃ. anatikkamanīyā ca bodhisattamātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittenāti.
mn123:10.3: yampi bhante, …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:11.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:11.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti. lābhinī bodhisattamātā hoti pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ. sā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāretīti.
mn123:11.3: yampi bhante, …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:12.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:12.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti. na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati. sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā. bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
mn123:12.3: seyyathāpi ānanda, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato. tatrāssa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā.
mn123:12.4: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya: ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato. tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vāti.
mn123:12.5: evameva kho ānanda, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti. na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati. sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā. bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ ahīnindriyanti.
mn123:12.6: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:13.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:13.2: sattāhajāte ānanda, bodhisatte bodhisattamātā kālaṃ karoti. tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjatī’ti.
mn123:13.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:14.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:14.2: yathā kho panānanda aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti. na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati. daseva māsāni bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyatīti.
mn123:14.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:15.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:15.2: yathā kho panānanda, aññā itthikā nisinnā vā nipannā vā vijāyanti. na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati. ṭhitāva kho bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyatīti.
mn123:15.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:16.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:16.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, devā naṃ paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti, pacchā manussāti.
mn123:16.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:17.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:17.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, appattova bodhisatto pathaviṃ hoti. cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti: attamanā devi hohi, mahesakkho te putto uppannoti.
mn123:17.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:18.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:18.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visadova nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena, amakkhito ruhirena, amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado.
mn123:18.3: seyyathāpi ānanda, maṇiratanaṃ kāsike vatthe nikkhittaṃ, neva maṇiratanaṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ makkheti. nāpi kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ maṇiratanaṃ makkheti.
mn123:18.6: evameva kho ānanda, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visadova nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visadoti.
mn123:18.7: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:19.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:19.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti: ekā sītassa, ekā uṇhassa, yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu cāti.
mn123:19.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:20.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:20.2: sampati jāto ānanda, bodhisatto samehi pādehi paṭhaviyaṃ patiṭṭhahitvā uttarābhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati. setamhi chatte anuhīramāne sabbā ca disā viloketi āsabhiṃca vācaṃ bhāsati: ‘aggohamasmi lokassa, seṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, ayamantimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo’ti.
mn123:20.3: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:21.1: sammukhā metaṃ bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
mn123:21.2: yadā ānanda, bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati. atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
mn123:21.3: yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yatthapime candimasūriyā evaṃ mahiddhikā evaṃ mahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti. tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
mn123:21.4: yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti: aññepi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannāti.
mn123:21.5: ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampati, sampakampati, sampavedhati. appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvanti.
mn123:21.6: yampi bhante …pe… idampāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremīti.
mn123:22.1: tasmātiha tvaṃ ānanda, idampi tathāgatassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhārehi.
mn123:22.2: idhānanda, tathāgatassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti. viditā upaṭṭhahanti. viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn123:22.4: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti. viditā upaṭṭhahanti. viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn123:22.5: idampi kho tvaṃ ānanda, tathāgatassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhārehīti.
mn123:23.1: yampi bhante, bhagavato viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
mn123:23.3: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn123:23.4: idampāhaṃ bhante bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremīti.
mn123:23.7: attamanā ca te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
